hypotheses.D0_native_suffix_recomposition_is_exact: Independent native prefix and boundary-suffix execution agree in context coefficients to relative error at most 1e-6.
hypotheses.D1_final_carried_state_predicts_operator: A discovery-frozen linear map from Layer-16 current-position state reaches at least 0.95 operator fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.D2_final_state_improves_on_embedding_cha: The Layer-16 state predictor exceeds the native-token-embedding predictor by at least 0.05 on every corpus.
hypotheses.D3_final_predictor_beats_matched_respons: The Layer-16 predictor exceeds the p95 of 16 coarse-class-and-position-matched response permutations by at least 0.10 on every corpus.
hypotheses.D4_early_state_is_causally_recoverable: Mean replacement after Block 0 retains at least 0.90 operator fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.D5_final_state_is_causally_necessary: Mean replacement after Block 16 retains at most 0.80 operator fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.D6_causal_dependence_grows_with_depth: Mean-replacement fidelity drops by at least 0.15 from Block 0 to Block 16 on every corpus.
hypotheses.D7_cyclic_final_state_is_material: Cyclic Layer-16 state substitution retains at most 0.80 operator fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.D8_decodability_precedes_causal_commitme: Every corpus has at least one tested boundary whose predictor reaches 0.80 while mean replacement still retains 0.90.
hypotheses.D9_compilation_boundary_transfers: The first tested boundary below 0.90 mean-replacement fidelity differs by at most four layers across corpora.
hypotheses.D10_context_span_chart_is_useful_at_the_: A predictor using only Layer-16 projections onto the tensor context span reaches at least 0.80 fidelity on every corpus.
